findings.summary: The translated HX2DP routine negates a signed minimum exponent and increments through signed maximum on an inclusive scaling loop. Magnitudes near these extremes can require billions of multiplications.
findings.repair: Only syntactically valid exponents in signed32 outside ±1024 are mapped to the same-sign binary64 saturation exponent before canonical HX2DP. The sidecar avoids original extreme calls. Public checks compare guarded results against actual safe canonical inputs; malformed integer exponents still reach CSPICE.
